chapters.title: 1. The teachers of the purpose of existence.

opener.composition: grandest 1200-wide panel: centered low sun + full symmetric fan, herd band, tide strip, masks-pair right, 4 gulls, 6 sparks

chapters.palette_role: climbing-morning essay: gold masses, vermilion bellwether, foam linework
chapters.rationale: Programmatic opener, longest in cohort (1239w): herd instinct as species-essence, ebb/flood law, heroes on stage, comedy/tragedy as preservation, closing 'We, too, have our time!'. Grandest panel + grandest title proportional to text.
chapters.caption: Ebb and flood — the comedy of existence.

chapters.title: 2. Intellectual conscience.

opener.composition: centered emblem: tilted beam, low pan vs high pan

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: gold beam, foam pans
chapters.rationale: Lonely conscience watches the majority 'handling their scales'; their weights are underweight. Tilted balance is the one concrete image.

chapters.title: 3. Noble and common.

opener.composition: seabands base + horizon; sunlow left + full fan; wink x1.6 right-of-center; 2 gulls; 3 sparks

chapters.palette_role: climbing-morning essay: suspicion under morning
chapters.rationale: Common natures wink at nobility, suspect hidden advantage, laugh at the sparkle in the noble eye; closes on 'the eternal injustice of the noble'.
chapters.caption: They give a wink — suspicion of the noble.

chapters.title: 4. What preserves the species.

opener.composition: centered emblem: three flame tongues over ember dots on ash line

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: gold/vermilion/core tongues
chapters.rationale: Strongest evil spirits 'rekindled the dozing passions'; flame catching on cold embers.

chapters.title: 5. Unconditional duties.

opener.composition: centered emblem: herald drum, crossed sticks, beat ticks

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: vermilion shell, foam head
chapters.rationale: Pathos-merchants need the unconditional ought as drumbeat (revolutionaries, preachers, Mazzini); 'the most eloquent gestures and postures' = herald performance.

chapters.title: 6. Loss of dignity.

opener.composition: centered emblem: striding head with gear works, stride tick

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: bone head, gold works
chapters.rationale: Reflection lost ceremony; we think walking; 'unstoppable machine' in the head. Striding head with works inside.

chapters.title: 7. Something for the industrious.

opener.composition: furrows lower half to horizon; sunlow + full fan upper-left; 1 gull

chapters.palette_role: climbing-morning essay: gold furrows on sea
chapters.rationale: Moral study as 'immense field of work'; unwritten histories (love/avarice/envy); 'why does the sun of one fundamental moral judgement shine here'; future cyclops-buildings.
chapters.caption: An immense field of work — the moral sun not yet risen.

chapters.title: 8. Unconscious virtues.

opener.composition: centered emblem: gold lens ring over reptile-scale arcs

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: gold ring, foam scales
chapters.rationale: Real virtues hide like 'subtle sculptures on the scales of reptiles', visible only under a microscope not yet invented; lens ring = 'artificially sharpened eye'.

chapters.title: 9. Our eruptions.

opener.composition: centered emblem: sprout breaking soil line, root ticks

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: vermilion leaves, gold stem
chapters.rationale: Feeble traits 'suddenly emerge into the light much later'; 'hidden gardens and plantations'; sprout breaking soil carries the botanic register.

chapters.title: 10. A kind of atavism.

opener.composition: centered emblem: closed-eye ancestor oval on night crescent

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: bone oval, night crescent
chapters.rationale: Rare humans as 'late ghosts of past cultures' to nurse/defend/honor; closed-eye ancestor oval on night crescent.

chapters.title: 11. Consciousness (Bewußtsein)6

opener.composition: centered emblem: open calm eye, gold iris

chapters.palette_role: ember morning: vermilion veil, gold iris
chapters.rationale: Consciousness unfinished/unrobust; 'perish with open eyes'; knowledge-becoming-instinct 'only beginning to dawn on the human eye'. First of eye-rhyme triptych (p3c11 -> p3c45 -> p3c53).

chapters.title: 12. On the aim of science.

opener.composition: centered emblem: two crossing strands, gold + vermilion

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: intertwined gold/vermilion
chapters.rationale: Pleasure/displeasure intertwined — 'jubilate up to the heavens' requires 'grief unto death'. Two crossing strands.

chapters.title: 13. On the doctrine of the feeling of power.

opener.composition: hand-open large right over bands; sunlow left + fan; dependents below as ticks; 2 equal-dot ticks facing the hand

chapters.palette_role: climbing-morning essay: benefiting/hurting hand
chapters.rationale: Benefiting/hurting both power exercised; pain asks its cause, pleasure stops with itself; knightly courtesy toward equals. Extended hand over dependents and equals.
chapters.caption: Benefiting and hurting — power over dependents and equals.

chapters.title: 14. The things people call love.

opener.composition: grasp upper-center over paled bands (.55); spark-triplet ideal-star above

chapters.palette_role: climbing-morning essay: paled ground, friendship star
chapters.rationale: Greed/love one instinct named twice; outstretched hands; most beautiful landscape tires in three months; friendship as the shared higher thirst.
chapters.caption: We stretch out our hands again — until friendship.

chapters.title: 15. From a distance.

opener.composition: centered emblem: silhouette + climber dot + disenchantment tick

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: sea mass, vermilion climber
chapters.rationale: Mountain enchants only from below and distance; climb it and the magic dies. Silhouette + tiny climber + disenchantment tick.

chapters.title: 16. Over the footbridge.

opener.composition: centered emblem: footbridge arc, one end broken, torrent ticks

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: gold arc, wave torrent
chapters.rationale: 'Do you want to cross the footbridge to me?' — refused; now mountains and torrents divide. The bridge is the story; one end broken.

chapters.title: 17. Finding a motive for one’s poverty.

opener.composition: centered emblem: trickle cradled in laurel arc

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: foam trickle, gold arc
chapters.rationale: Wise gardener 'places the poor little stream in his garden in the arms of a nymph'. Trickle cradled in laurel; quiet for 97w.

chapters.title: 18. Ancient pride.

opener.composition: centered emblem: Greek column stub + rank staircase

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: bone column
chapters.rationale: Ancient nobility's hue needed distance — the Greek 'could barely see the slave clearly any more, not even Plato'; column stub + rank staircase = the 'immense intermediate stages'.

chapters.title: 19. Evil.

opener.composition: centered emblem: windswept tree, storm slashes

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: gold branches, foam storm
chapters.rationale: No proud tree without storms; poison killing the weak strengthens the strong. Windswept tree, quiet for 93w.

chapters.title: 20. The dignity of foolishness.

opener.composition: centered emblem: jester cap over snapped ledger line

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: vermilion cap, gold bells
chapters.rationale: Under coming tyranny of prudence 'to be noble might then come to mean: to entertain follies'. Cap outlasting the snapped ledger, quiet.

chapters.title: 21. To the teachers of selflessness.

opener.composition: tablets monumental center on herd arc below; stern narrow 5-ray fan; iron desaturation

chapters.palette_role: iron morning: monumental bone tablets, desaturated fan
chapters.rationale: 'Teachers of...' pair with p3c1, 957w: virtues praised for society's use while dominating possessors; closing self-refutation — neighbour preaches 'Thou shalt' and 'Thou shalt not' in the same breath. Monumental iron, formally unique.
chapters.caption: [Thou shalt] and [Thou shalt not] — preached in the same breath.

chapters.title: 22. L’ordre du jour pour le roi.12

opener.composition: curtain valance full-width top; bell large left + arcs; torn slip center-right; low sun + fan behind

chapters.palette_role: stage morning: vermilion-forward court
chapters.rationale: Most formally eccentric: staged court-day monologue; bad weather unspoken; Montaigne's stone; unknown programme ('we don't know the programme! So we have to improvise'); fifth-hour tower bell ends the dream. Italic title.
chapters.caption: The fifth hour — a morning dream of ceremony.

chapters.title: 23. The signs of corruption.

opener.composition: branch upper-left; apples falling center over night-deepened bands; one apple seeding below the band line

chapters.palette_role: autumn morning: night-deepened ground, vermilion apples
chapters.rationale: Corruption as a people's autumn — colourful superstition vs pale faith; tyrants/Caesar; Napoleon's 'That is me'; apples as seed-bearers of the future.
chapters.caption: Corruption — the autumn of a people.

chapters.title: 24. Different forms of dissatisfaction.

opener.composition: centered emblem: wine cup vs medicine cup

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: vermilion wine, foam medicine
chapters.rationale: Weak discontents take opiates; strong take physicians — 'they resent those who esteem physicians above priests'. Wine cup vs medicine cup.

chapters.title: 25. Not predestined for knowledge.

opener.composition: centered emblem: averted profile, receding spark, heel-turn arc

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: bone profile, turning arc
chapters.rationale: Stupid humility 'turns on his heel' from the striking — 'too many old truths'. Averted profile, quiet.

chapters.title: 26. What is life?

opener.composition: centered emblem: S-snake + discarded slough arc

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: gold living curve, pale slough
chapters.rationale: Life = 'continually shedding something that wants to die', against Moses' 'thou shalt not kill'. Slough, quiet for 67w.

chapters.title: 27. The renouncer.

opener.composition: centered emblem: hooded rising triangle + falling ballast stones

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: bone hood, night ballast
chapters.rationale: Renouncer casts ballast to soar higher, 'shrouded in his hood' — secretly an affirmer, 'cleverer than we thought'.

chapters.title: 28. Harming with what is best in oneself.

opener.composition: centered emblem: overexposed disc + blind-spot wedge + prone ticks

chapters.palette_role: glare morning: swollen core, vermilion blind spot
chapters.rationale: The great destroy the weak 'precisely with what is best in them'; their best acts 'like an overly potent drink'; the weak, intoxicated, 'break their limbs'. Overexposed morning disc: too much of a good light (PF-1).

chapters.title: 29. The add-on-liars.

opener.composition: centered emblem: prompter half-dome + whisper dots

chapters.palette_role: stage morning: vermilion dome, foam whispers
chapters.rationale: French unities quarrel — conservatives invent reasons for old habits after the fact ('one lied to oneself, inventing reasons for these laws'). Prompter whispering excuses; stage tone, quiet.

chapters.title: 30. The comedy of the famous.

opener.composition: duet: plumes fanned left + mask-fall small right, shared baseline

chapters.palette_role: stage morning: gold/foam/vermilion plumes, falling mask
chapters.rationale: Famous men borrow splendour/fear/feigned idleness from a rotating cast ('visionary... expert... thinker... pedant') whose surroundings die off; 'push... onto the stage'. Plumes + mask duet.

chapters.title: 31. Trade and nobility.

opener.composition: duet: bow crossed over level scales, centered

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: gold bow over level scales
chapters.rationale: Trade common as reading, as hunting once was; nobles may one day trade as 'luxury of sentiment' — 'the noble might enjoy trade as much as they hitherto enjoyed war'. Bow over LEVEL scales duet.

chapters.title: 32. Undesired disciples.

opener.composition: centered emblem: open gold ring + half-closed foam ring on shared baseline

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: gold open ring, foam half ring
chapters.rationale: The corrupter rejects two disciples — one 'can't say 'no'', the other says 'half and half'; his doctrine needs 'a warlike soul, a desire to hurt, a delight in saying no'. Two failed verdict-closures (PF-2).

chapters.title: 33. Outside the lecture-room.

opener.composition: centered emblem: cold suspicion-wink

chapters.palette_role: iron morning: suspicion rhyming p3c3
chapters.rationale: Man became distrustful, more evil, late — 'Because he now has a science'. Cold suspicion-wink in iron tone rhymes p3c3's essay (inverted direction: science makes man suspicious).

chapters.title: 34. Historia abscondita.20

opener.composition: centered emblem: sunbeam wedge into vault arcs, 3 rising secret-dots

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: gold beam, core secret-dots
chapters.rationale: Great humans exert retroactive force — 'a thousand secrets of the past crawl out of their hiding places — into his sunshine'. Beam + rising secret-dots, quiet.

chapters.title: 35. Heresy and witchcraft.

opener.composition: centered emblem: stake + flame + snapped halo

chapters.palette_role: shadow morning: night veil, vermilion flame
chapters.rationale: Thinking otherwise = heresy, 'the adjunct of witchcraft'; Reformation 'redoubled the medieval spirit'. Stake + snapped halo in shadow tone, quiet.

chapters.title: 36. Last words.

opener.composition: mask-fall large center-left; laurel right; pillows heavy bottom; low sun with night-occluded lower third

chapters.palette_role: stage morning: falling mask, smothering pillows
chapters.rationale: Augustus lets the mask fall ('Plaudite amici, comoedia finita est!'); Nero 'qualis artifex'; Tiberius silent, smothered with pillows into double death. Roman theatre landmark; landmark by semantics, not length.
chapters.caption: Plaudite, amici — the mask falls; Tiberius is smothered.

chapters.title: 37. Because of three errors.

opener.composition: centered emblem: three candles tall/mid/short before altar arc

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: foam candles, gold flames
chapters.rationale: Science promoted through three errors — God (Newton), utility (Voltaire), innocence (Spinoza). Three candles, quiet.

chapters.title: 38. The explosive ones.

opener.composition: centered emblem: lit match diagonal over keg stave-arcs

chapters.palette_role: ember morning: vermilion veil, gold match-flame
chapters.rationale: Young men are powder kegs thrilled by 'the sight of the burning match — not the cause itself'. Match over keg, ember tone, quiet.

chapters.title: 39. Changed taste.

opener.composition: centered emblem: tipped cup + taste-drop + ridiculum slash

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: foam cup, vermilion slash
chapters.rationale: Taste changes before opinions when shameless ones enforce 'hoc est ridiculum' — judgement of taste and disgust; physis (nutrition/digestion) as cause. Tipped cup + taste-drop.

chapters.title: 40. On the lack of noble style.

opener.composition: centered emblem: sword crossed over factory chimney

chapters.palette_role: iron morning: stern gold sword, pale chimney
chapters.rationale: Military culture above industrial — soldiers/leaders outrank workers/employers; workers submit to 'unknown and uninteresting persons'; bloodsucking employer 'dog'. Sword vs chimney, stern iron.

chapters.title: 41. Against remorse.

opener.composition: centered emblem: flask + bubbles + trial tick

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: gold liquor, foam glass
chapters.rationale: Thinker treats acts as experiments — success/failure are answers; remorse belongs to the ordered-about expecting 'a beating'. Flask + trial tick, quiet.

chapters.title: 42. Work and boredom.

opener.composition: centered emblem: path to horizon + walker + bow-tip

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: gold path, hunting echo
chapters.rationale: Against work-for-wages — rare ones (artists, hunters, travellers, lovers) for whom 'work is not itself the reward of rewards' refuse; boredom as the 'lull' before 'a happy voyage'. Path + walker + bow-tip.

chapters.title: 43. What the laws betray.

opener.composition: centered emblem: law tablet cracked by night wedge

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: bone tablet, night wedge
chapters.rationale: Penal codes betray what a people finds foreign — Wahhabis' two mortal sins (other god + smoking); Romans' adultery + wine; Dionysian cult as 'foreign monster'. Tablet cracked by night wedge.

chapters.title: 44. The supposed motives.

opener.composition: centered emblem: lever gripped by night shadow-hand

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: gold lever, night hand
chapters.rationale: Believed-in motives matter more than real ones — 'the real lever of its conduct'; happiness/misery follow belief. Lever gripped by night shadow-hand, quiet.

chapters.title: 45. Epicurus.34

opener.composition: sunhigh top-center, the only overhead sun; whitesea + rocks + fish below; calm eye small center; 5 sparks; no horizon darkness

chapters.palette_role: THE noon-flash: brightest panel, sun-core wash, gold title
chapters.rationale: 'The happiness of the afternoon of antiquity'; calm eye over 'wide whitish sea'; sun-bathed rocks; creatures secure 'like the light and his eye itself'; 'sea of existence has grown still'. The single noon-flash: only overhead sun, only gold title, brightest panel. Landmark by luminosity, not length.
chapters.caption: The afternoon of antiquity — the sea of existence grown still.

chapters.title: 46. Our amazement.

opener.composition: centered emblem: iron C-clamp, one jaw sprung

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: foam clamp, gold screw (morning tone)
chapters.rationale: Inner life once 'fastened to iron necessity with eternal clamps'; now shipwrecked men marvelling on firm earth. Sprung clamp (old faith sprung open by change).

chapters.title: 47. On the suppression of the passions.

opener.composition: centered emblem: muzzled court mouth + Versailles bow

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: foam lips, gold strap
chapters.rationale: Forbidding passion's expression (Louis XIV court) atrophies passion into 'graceful, shallow, playful manner'. Muzzled court mouth.

chapters.title: 48. Knowledge of distress.

opener.composition: manacle large center on darkened bands; rayfan opacity .35 (file minimum); no gulls; 1 guttering spark

chapters.palette_role: shadow morning: dimmed rays, iron ring — light persists, NOT night
chapters.rationale: Darkest essay — ages divided by knowledge of distress; 'age of fear, the longest of all ages'; cruelty-to-self as training; closing recipe: 'distress'. Dimmed rays (.35, lowest), iron ring, no gulls.
chapters.caption: The age of fear — the recipe against distress is distress.

chapters.title: 49. Magnanimity and related things.

opener.composition: centered emblem: wheel hub + 6 spokes + 5 flung drops

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: gold wheel, vermilion drops
chapters.rationale: Magnanimity is centrifugal — 'sudden satiety and sudden nausea'; feeling flung to opposites (cold/laughter/tears); revenge drunk to the last drop then nausea. Wheel + flung drops.

chapters.title: 50. The argument from growing solitary.

opener.composition: centered emblem: one figure ringed by 8 cold-dot faces

chapters.palette_role: iron morning: gold figure, cold foam ring
chapters.rationale: Fear of a cold look outweighs conscience — 'What is he really afraid of? Growing solitary!'; 'Thus the herd instinct speaks out in us' (herd bookend with p3c1). One figure ringed by 8 faces, iron tone, quiet.

chapters.title: 51. The sense of truth.

opener.composition: centered emblem: single spark, nothing more

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: single foam spark
chapters.rationale: Shortest in cohort (55w): 'Let's try it!' or silence — courage keeps its right only where experiment admits. Single spark, nothing more.

chapters.title: 52. What others know about us.

opener.composition: centered emblem: mouths + expanding echo waves

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: foam mouths, gold echoes
chapters.rationale: What others know 'assails us' from outside; 'easier to deal with a bad conscience than a bad reputation'. Mouths + echo waves, quiet.

chapters.title: 53. Where the good begins.

opener.composition: centered emblem: dull dim eye (deliberate rhyme with p3c11)

chapters.palette_role: dim morning: eye at .78/.65 — closes the triptych
chapters.rationale: 'The duller the eye, the more extensive the good'; cheerful common vs gloomy great thinkers. Dim eye closes the eye-rhyme triptych p3c11/p3c45/p3c53; reuse of gs-b-eye is the deliberate rhyme.

chapters.title: 54. The consciousness of appearance.

opener.composition: ridge + dreamer center over void; morning fan he must not wake to; 2 leapers in margins; masks-pair tiny; 4 will-o-wisp sparks

chapters.palette_role: dream morning: night veil, saturated fan, core wisps
chapters.rationale: Philosophical climax — ancient humanity fabulates within; 'as the sleepwalker has to go on dreaming in order to avoid falling down'; appearance 'not a dead mask'; 'will-o'-the-wisp and a dance of spirits'; knower as 'master of ceremony'. Italic title; leapers hand Book One onward.
chapters.caption: Go on dreaming lest you fall — the knower joins the dance.

chapters.title: 55. The ultimate noblemindedness.

opener.composition: centered emblem: stone altar + lone tall flame + void tick

chapters.palette_role: climbing morning: bone altar, lone gold flame
chapters.rationale: Nobility = singularity — 'heat in things that feel cold to everyone else'; scale not yet invented; 'sacrifice on altars made for an unknown god'; courage without honours. Lone flame.

chapters.title: 56. The desire for suffering.

opener.composition: centered emblem: horizon monster + crowd ticks

chapters.palette_role: closing morning: ember horizon hands to Book Two
chapters.rationale: Closer — bored young Europe invents emergencies; imagination turns unhappiness 'into a monster ahead of time so that afterwards it can fight a monster'; ends 'I have ventured to paint my happiness on the wall'. Ember horizon hands to Book Two; NOT landmark.

grammar_notes: Emblem Cabinet within NOON: fixed climbing-morning light; 44 marks + 6 essay panels + 6 landmark panels + 2 duets. Light discipline: 55 mornings, 1 noon-flash (p3c45), 1 dimmed morning (p3c48). Eye-rhyme triptych p3c11/p3c45/p3c53; herd bookends p3c1/p3c50/p3c56; theatre frame p3c1/p3c54. PF-1 gs-b-flare (p3c28), PF-2 gs-b-halves (p3c32); gs-b-twodoors retired. Palette: NOON contract tokens only; #2A1540 absent.
